name: FITRON / SELL AGENT brand tokens
source: Derived from the FITRON logo (gold mark on near-black) and the approved UI mockups: dark gold chrome (sidebar, header, splash, live call) with light content surfaces. Single source of truth for Windows desktop and both Android apps.

typography.android_font_family: sans-serif (Roboto) with Noto Sans Devanagari for Hindi

logo.original_png: packages/brand/assets/fitron_logo.png (place the original file here; not committed by default)
logo.clear_space: Keep at least 12% of the mark width clear on every side.
logo.usage: Gold mark on #0B0B0B only. Never recolor the mark; never place on light backgrounds.

layout.desktop: Dark sidebar (#0B0B0B) with gold logo + 'SELL AGENT' wordmark (gold second word), gold-highlighted active item; white header with search, status chips (Local AI, Backend, Galaxy S25), notifications, operator avatar; light content area (#F7F6F2) with white cards, gold primary buttons (#D4AF37 text #0B0B0B), status chips (green/amber/red/blue on tinted backgrounds).
layout.android: Splash and live-call screens dark (#0B0B0B + gold); all other screens light (#F7F6F2/#FFFFFF) with gold primary buttons, dark header text, bottom navigation Home / Contacts / Campaigns / Calls / More with gold active icon; emergency/end-call red (#C62828).
layout.rule: Gold is the only accent. Dark chrome + light content. Emergency stop/end call is the only red filled button.
